explanation: The December 16, 2020 FOMC meeting introduced substantive new forward guidance by tying asset purchases explicitly to 'substantial further progress' toward employment and inflation goals (outcome-based qualitative guidance), which market participants had widely anticipated but which was formally adopted at this meeting. This shift in QE guidance framework — moving from open-ended to threshold-based language — was a material policy change that could plausibly explain a structural break in financial market data around December 29, 2020, as markets digested and repriced the implications of this new framework in the days following the meeting.
